THE TIER LINE THIS REVIEW DRAWS, because it is the whole point: rows use compact keys, and only part of them are DECODED BY THE APP'S OWN SHIPPED DECODER (bundle chunk 09373ik9or5q1: m/n/t/i mint/name/symbol/image, mc usd_market_cap, age SECONDS-SINCE-CREATION - a duration, not an instant - gd graduation with complete iff gd>0, dw dev wallet, pl/lv/desc/vid/ic/rid/ms). The volume family (v v5 v15 v1h v24h and the vUsd twins), the trade counts (tx5 txc) and bonding progress (p) are decoded by NOTHING in the app: their meanings are INFERRED from their names, normalize::semantics tags every such value undecoded_compact_key_inferred_from_name_*, and nothing downstream may treat them as measured quantities until a stability check against another source pins them. They are listed here under their WIRE names and are never renamed, because renaming an undecoded field is how a fabricated number gets born. REQUIRED is the intersection rule the discovery and coin_exact reviews use: a leaf is required only if the normalizer reads it AND it appeared on every one of the 525 rows; everything else observed anywhere is in the CLOSED optional set, so an unreviewed leaf refuses the page rather than being silently projected away. vid is decoder-known but appeared on NO observed row and is deliberately NOT in the closed set - a review covers only pages someone looked at, so its first appearance must refuse and be amended in from the retained bytes. AMENDED 2026-08-24, same day, by exactly that path: the keeper's first live tap was REFUSED (refused_row_carries_unreviewed_leaf) because the live board carried a mayhem coin none of the five survey pages had - $/ms:string (mayhem state, app-decoded, observed value active) with $/mm:string beside it (undecoded; observed value auto; inferred a mayhem-mode marker, matching in-memory-coin's mayhemMode). Both were read back from a fresh live page against the retained refusal and moved into the closed optional set; ms is normalizer-read but stays optional because it appears only on mayhem rows. MEASURED CONSTRAINTS THIS LISTING RIDES ON: limit is honoured to 150 then SILENTLY CLAMPS (200 and 500 each returned exactly 150 rows, HTTP 200, no warning - the /coins-to-70 family; the keeper asks 150 and the envelope restates the ask); the board is a PERSONALISED recommendation feed (rid is a recommendation id and the app can send userId/session_id/country, which the catalog deliberately does not allowlist), so position is not rank, membership is not a census, and absence from the board is never evidence of absence; the envelope's provider-stated serverTs (epoch millis) is the first provider-side availability instant on any discovery feed in this catalog and stays in the retained exact bytes OUTSIDE this row gate - deriving from it needs its own reviewed projection, deliberately not smuggled through this one.
